summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved lists not persisting  **What I found from reading the code (no changes made):**  I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` → SQLite.  - Client always sends `credentials: "include"` (cookies), and the app already gates `WatchlistPage` behind `useAuth()` — an unauthenticated user gets `LoginPage`, never a hollow watchlist screen (`App.tsx:32`). - Sessions are stored in the `sessions` table (token → user_id), not in memory, with a 30-day cookie (`modules/auth/handlers.ts`). Re-lo
